title.en: An Act Renaming Barangay New Alabang Village in the City of Muntinlupa as Barangay Ayala Alabang
title.orig: An Act Renaming Barangay New Alabang Village in the City of Muntinlupa as Barangay Ayala Alabang

text.en: Barangay New Alabang Village in the City of Muntinlupa ishereby renamed as Barangay Ayala Alabang.

The renaming of Barangat New Alabang Village as Barangay Ayala Alabang shall be effective upon ratification of the majority of the votes cast by qualified voters in a plebiscite to be conducted and supervised by the Commission on Elections in the present Barangay New Alabang Village within one hundred twenty (120) days after the effectivity of this Act.
The expenses for such plebiscite shall be borne by the City of Muntinlupa.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
